nodes.guarantees: confidentiality and integrity of every object, ref, index and key file against anyone without the read key
nodes.does_not_guarantee: anything against a read-key holder; hiding sizes (TM-R08) or which objects change

nodes.guarantees: the host cannot substitute an object: bytes must hash to their id; on every download path since 0.21
nodes.does_not_guarantee: freshness for a fresh clone (the host can serve an old but authentic ref); collisions at 48 bits (TM-R07)

nodes.guarantees: a commit was signed by a key whose file decrypts under the read key
nodes.does_not_guarantee: who that is: any read-key holder can mint such a key (TM-R01)

nodes.guarantees: pull and clone refuse unsigned, bad or no-key commits made since the policy was switched on (signed-since-<head>)
nodes.does_not_guarantee: self-signed forgeries pass (TM-R01); other clients ignore it (A8); a vault that switched it on before 0.21 has no recorded start

nodes.guarantees: writable and read-only clones refuse a host that moves a branch backwards (--accept-rewind to override)
nodes.does_not_guarantee: a fresh clone has nothing to compare with

nodes.guarantees: a push that loses a race fails loudly and never overwrites the winner (in-memory and live per-op conflict)
nodes.does_not_guarantee: the very first write of a branch ref (no create-if-absent on the API, TM-R33)

nodes.guarantees: a clone never lowers the format number it has seen
nodes.does_not_guarantee: features and min_client follow the server's copy on merge, so a host replaying an older index can drop them (TM-R29); a fresh clone takes whatever the host serves

nodes.guarantees: vault data never writes outside the tree or into .git / .sg_vault in any spelling; every write/delete loop; resolved symlinks; .vault__*.zip backups
sgit never follows, commits or writes through a symlink inside the working copy
nodes.does_not_guarantee: links above the vault root are allowed (a symlinked home, /tmp)

nodes.guarantees: every secret goes through Vault__Secret_File: a 0600 temp file renamed into place, no readable window, no inherited mode, a link at the path replaced
nodes.does_not_guarantee: directories are 0755 (names visible); not enforced on Windows

nodes.guarantees: commit and write refuse any zip holding a vault or signing key and any hard link to a .sg_vault/local file; the always-ignored set keeps .env*, .netrc and SSH private keys out
nodes.does_not_guarantee: a plain copy of the key's text, a repacked .tgz, a zip with bytes prepended (TM-R34); a tracked .env stays tracked (TM-R09)

nodes.guarantees: a vault records its server; SGIT_DEFAULT_BASE_URL naming another server on an unrecorded vault refuses
nodes.does_not_guarantee: http:// servers are allowed with a warning (TM-R10)

nodes.guarantees: https, or http to loopback only; timeout 300 s; bytes still verified
unit and security suites cannot reach the network
release actions SHA-pinned; PyPI publish only from main; sgit update runs pip with -I
nodes.does_not_guarantee: sgit update installs the latest sgit-ai unpinned; no dependency audit or static analysis gate in CI yet
